reasoning: A hybrid strategy combines autonomous reasoning with external explainability tools to ensure both domain-aware interpretation and rigorous, model-agnostic feature importance estimation. autonomous_tasks.query: Compare the input values for benign-typical features (low compactness, low concavity) to malignant-typical features (high values in concavity, texture, area) to assess which features deviate most from malignancy profiles.
autonomous_tasks.expected_output: A ranked list of features showing deviation from malignant patterns, indicating alignment with benign prediction
